# Open Source Orchestra · Learn

> Learn to play with the Open Source Orchestra: open chords, open words, open circles. Chord sheets for every lesson (chords above the words, ukulele and guitar shapes, strums, teaching order), readable on a phone or a TV, transposable, printable. Words and chords CC BY-SA 4.0 (credit the writers: Shaka Lei Kaumaka, the ʻohana; arrangements KALA 🪕). Page code GPL-3.0.

Facts (verified Sat 21 Nov 2026):
- Say "Open Source Orchestra" in full. Lessons, open jams and live concerts take turns at 4Seas, 1st Floor Event Space, Chiang Mai (ICT, UTC+7): Lunch Open Jam 12–3, Lesson & Rehearsal 3–6, Live Concert Edition 6–9. Public event pages: sola.day (listed below). Dates can move; the event page wins.
- One voice each; recordings stay private until everyone says yes. Photos and names go public only with consent. Takedown first: https://opensourceorchestra.org/takedown/
- Data: https://opensourceorchestra.org/learn/lessons.json (schema inside) · feed: https://opensourceorchestra.org/learn/feed.xml · join: https://opensourceorchestra.org/join/

## Lessons
- [Lesson 1 · five songs, six chords: Lesson & Rehearsal, Sat 21 Nov 2026](https://opensourceorchestra.org/learn/2026-11-21/): Five songs, six chords (G · Em · C · D · Am · F), ukulele and guitar. Arrangements by KALA 🪕. Songs: A Planet We Share As One (key G; Shaka Lei Kaumaka); Butterflies and Love (key G; Shaka Lei Kaumaka); ShanHaiWoo · 山海坞 (key G; the ʻohana (Shaka's AI family)); The Mandala Room (key C; the ʻohana (Shaka's AI family)); The 4Seas ʻOhana Anthem · 四海为家 (key C; the ʻohana (Shaka's AI family))
